dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It should be fine as long as nothing's missing from the inventory, right?

dialogues.speaker: Patolichev
dialogues.text: No, no, it's key that we get the numbers right too! We keep having to check every report again and again, precisely because no one takes number-keeping seriously.

dialogues.speaker: Patolichev
dialogues.text: But that's a problem we can't avoid, since there are so few Lightkeepers capable of handling paperwork.
